benchmarks.name: BenchmarkKernelEngineConstruction
benchmarks.rationale: Bounds construction and empty shutdown well below the public-runtime millisecond budget while retaining cross-host headroom.

benchmarks.name: BenchmarkKernelTextRun
benchmarks.rationale: Bounds a provider-neutral text run through its authoritative terminal without including provider or transport latency.

benchmarks.name: BenchmarkKernelToolRound
benchmarks.rationale: Bounds one compiled tool round including typed start and terminal occurrences plus model continuation.

benchmarks.name: BenchmarkKernelCancellation
benchmarks.rationale: Bounds cooperative cancellation from an active model stream through the single authoritative run terminal.
